summary: Camber Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of an amalgamation on June 1, 2026 between its subsidiary Simson-Maxwell Ltd. and T T Power Group Inc. under Canadian law (CBCA). The amalgamated entity operates Simson's former business. As a result, Viking Energy (Camber's subsidiary) received 5,750,000 Class A Preference Shares with no voting rights, while T T's sole shareholder obtained 100,000 Class A Common Shares (100% voting interest). This restructuring follows a prior deconsolidation of Simson in April 2025. No price per share or premium is stated. A unanimous shareholders agreement appointed the T T shareholder as sole director. The filing is a structural reorganization rather than a classic acquisition or spin-off, with no public market terms.
